title: Add supportsSceneAsset capability field and unknownMethod gate
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Add supportsSceneAsset capability field and unknownMethod gate
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L228-229: "`supportsSceneAsset` (Boolean): `true` if the server supports the SceneAsset methods on this account. When `false`, a call to any SceneAsset method returns an `unknownMethod` error ({{RFC8620}} Section 3.6.2)."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-types/src/capability.rs:53-71; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/asset.rs:53-130; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/backend.rs:526-534
Now: SceneCapability has no supports_scene_asset field. The SceneAsset handlers never check support. supports_type is documented as 'Not called by the handlers'.
Change: Add `supports_scene_asset: bool` to SceneCapability (consider serde default true for older peers). In each SceneAsset/* handler, return JmapError::unknown_method() when the account capability says false (or supports_type::<SceneAsset> is false).
